text: The Legend of Sleepy Hollow is a scenario for Arkham Horror: The Card Game based on the classic horror story by Washington Irving. This scenario can be played as a standalone scenario, or as a side-story during any campaign.
This scenario would not have been possible without the amazing design framework created by Matt Newman, Nate French and everyone involved in Arkham Horror: The Card Game at FFG.

notes: This scenario is an unofficial fan creation and in no way endorsed by Fantasy Flight Games. All rights to artwork belong to the relevant artists.

key.theInvestigatorsBanishedTheHeadlessHorse: The investigators banished the Headless Horseman from Sleepy Hollow.
